rca_of_issue:
Root Cause Analysis of Item Card Not Expanding Bug:

Issue: Item cards were not expanding when clicked. The item body (ITEM TYPE, BRAND, MODEL, etc.) was not rendering at all.

Root Cause: State initialization was happening directly in the component body (lines 36-40 in index.tsx):
```javascript
if (items.length === 0) {
  const firstItem = createEmptyItem(jobId, 1);
  setItems([firstItem]);
  setExpandedItem(firstItem.id);
}
```

This is a React anti-pattern. State updates in the component body cause:
1. Re-renders on every render cycle
2. State inconsistencies
3. The expandedItem state not matching the actual item.id
4. Conditional rendering (line 206: `{isExpanded && ...}`) failing

Reproduction Steps:
1. Load app at http://localhost:3000
2. Scroll to 'Repair Items (1)' section
3. Item card shows 'Item 1 — ⌚ Watch' but body is not visible
4. Clicking on item header does nothing
5. Page HTML does not contain 'ITEM TYPE' or 'BRAND' text

Mitigation: Moved state initialization to useState initializer:
```javascript
const initialItem = useState(() => createEmptyItem(jobId, 1))[0];
const [items, setItems] = useState<RepairItem[]>([initialItem]);
const [expandedItem, setExpandedItem] = useState<string|null>(initialItem.id);
```

This ensures:
1. State is initialized only once on component mount
2. No re-renders caused by state updates in component body
3. expandedItem correctly matches the first item's id
4. Item card expands by default as intended

Verification: After fix, item card expands by default showing all fields (ITEM TYPE, BRAND, MODEL, etc.). Collapse/expand toggle works correctly.
